title: Data Scientist
summary: Data scientists use statistics, programming and machine learning to answer questions and make predictions from data. It suits students who enjoy maths, coding and digging into why something happens.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Roadmap – roadmap.sh
AI and Data Scientist Roadmap (PDF) – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Python, NumPy and pandas
nodes.summary: Learn Python basics, then NumPy arrays and pandas DataFrames for loading, cleaning and reshaping data. Almost all data science work and interviews use Python.

resources.title: Kaggle Learn (free Python and pandas courses)

nodes.proof: A notebook that loads a public dataset with pandas and answers five questions, each with code and a sentence of explanation.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Roadmap – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: SQL
nodes.summary: Write queries with joins, grouping and window functions. Company data usually lives in databases, and SQL questions are common in data science interviews.

resources.title: CS50's Introduction to Databases with SQL – Harvard

nodes.proof: Connect Python to a SQLite database and write queries that answer five business questions.

nodes.title: Linear algebra and calculus for data science
nodes.summary: Revise vectors, matrices, eigenvalues and derivatives with a focus on intuition. You need these to understand how models are trained, not to do proofs.

resources.title: Data Science for Engineers – NPTEL (IIT Madras)

nodes.proof: Implement linear regression from scratch with NumPy using matrix operations and compare it with a library result.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Roadmap (PDF) – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Statistics and A/B testing
nodes.summary: Learn probability, distributions, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and regression, then how A/B tests are designed and read. This is what separates data science from just running code.
nodes.proof: A notebook analysing a simulated or public A/B test: the hypothesis, the test, the p-value or interval, and a plain-English decision.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Roadmap (PDF) – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Exploratory analysis and visualisation
nodes.summary: Clean messy data, look at distributions and relationships, and make clear charts before modelling. Good EDA often finds the answer, or shows the data cannot support it.
nodes.proof: An EDA notebook on a messy public dataset that lists every cleaning step and ends with three insights backed by charts.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Projects – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Machine learning with scikit-learn
nodes.summary: Learn regression, classification, trees, ensembles and clustering, plus train/validation/test splits, overfitting, and metrics like precision, recall and AUC. Interviews test these concepts closely.

resources.title: Machine Learning Crash Course – Google for Developers
Introduction to Machine Learning – NPTEL (IIT Madras)

nodes.proof: A scikit-learn pipeline that compares three models on one dataset with cross-validation and explains why you picked the winner.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Roadmap (PDF) – roadmap.sh
Top 60+ Data Science Interview Questions – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Introduction to deep learning
nodes.summary: Learn what neural networks are and train a simple one for images or text. Treat this as a second step: many entry-level data science roles lean more on statistics and classical ML.

resources.title: Intro to Deep Learning – Kaggle Learn
Practical Deep Learning for Coders – fast.ai

nodes.proof: A trained image or text classifier with a short note on accuracy, mistakes it makes and what you would try next.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Roadmap (PDF) – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Portfolio of data science projects
nodes.summary: Finish two or three projects that go from a real question to a result: data, EDA, a model, evaluation and a clear conclusion. Pick topics you can explain with confidence.

resources.title: AI and Data Scientist Projects – roadmap.sh

nodes.proof: A GitHub portfolio with 2–3 projects, each with a README stating the question, approach, metric and limits.

sources.title: AI and Data Scientist Projects – roadmap.sh
AI and Data Scientist Roadmap – roadmap.sh

nodes.title: Interview preparation and applying
nodes.summary: Revise statistics and ML concepts (bias-variance, regularisation, metrics), practise Python and SQL questions, and rehearse explaining your projects to a non-technical person.

resources.title: Top 60+ Data Science Interview Questions – roadmap.sh
30 SQL Queries Interview Questions and Answers – roadmap.sh

nodes.proof: Answer the roadmap.sh data science question set out loud, and do a mock interview walking through one project end to end.
